description: This script generates C++ code for texture format mapping in the ANGLE project, involving JSON data processing and code templating.

methods.name: get_swizzle_format_id
methods.description: Determines the swizzle format ID based on internal format and angle format properties.

methods.name: get_blit_srv_format
methods.description: Returns the appropriate DXGI format for blitting or shader resource view based on angle format.

methods.name: json_to_table_data
methods.description: Converts JSON format data into a C++ format entry string.

methods.name: parse_json_angle_format_case
methods.description: Parses angle format JSON data to determine support and fallback cases.

methods.name: parse_json_into_switch_angle_format_string
methods.description: Generates switch-case code snippets for different internal formats based on JSON data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function handling code generation process, JSON data loading, and output file writing.
